data.label: CS Mastery Blueprint
data.description: Strategic 12-month blueprint for high-tier software engineering roles. Deep fundamentals, pattern-based DSA, and real-world project impact.

data.label: Phase 1: Foundation (0-3M)
data.description: Build programming confidence and logical thinking. Master a core language and start DSA early.
data.details:
🎯 Goal: Build Programming Confidence + Logical Thinking

1. Choose One Core Language: C++ (DSA focus), Java, or Python (AI focus).
2. Master Programming Fundamentals: Variables, Loops, Functions, Arrays, Strings, Recursion, Time complexity (Big-O).
3. Start DSA Early: Solve 150+ problems in 3 months on LeetCode (Easy), GFG, CodeStudio.
4. Version Control: Learn Git basics, push projects, maintain GitHub streak.

🎯 Milestone: 150+ problems solved.

data.label: Phase 2: Skill Building (3-6M)
data.description: Become internship-ready by mastering advanced DSA and choosing a specialized development path.
data.details:
🎯 Goal: Become Internship-Ready

1. Advanced DSA: Linked List, Trees, BST, Hashing, Sliding Window, Two Pointers. Target: 350+ problems.
2. Choose Development Path:
   - Option A: Web Dev (HTML, CSS, JS, React, Node, MongoDB)
   - Option B: Data Path (Python, NumPy, Pandas, SQL, Basic ML)
   - Option C: Cloud Path (Linux, Networking, AWS, Docker)
3. Build 3 Real Projects: Authentication system, Blog platform, Expense tracker, or E-commerce clone.
4. Resume Strategy: Impact-driven bullet points, problem-solving stats, clean structure.

🎯 Target: 350+ problems solved.

data.label: Phase 3: Advanced (6-12M)
data.description: Master patterns, system design basics, and execution of placement strategy.
data.details:
🎯 Goal: Crack Internship / Placement

1. Master Patterns in DSA: DP patterns, Graph patterns, Backtracking, Greedy, Binary search on answer. Target: 500+ problems.
2. System Design Basics: Scalability, Load Balancers, Database Indexing, Caching, API Rate Limiting, CAP Theorem.
3. Internship Strategy: Apply daily on LinkedIn, Cold message recruiters, Hackathons, Referrals.
4. Interview Preparation: Coding rounds, Technical rounds, HR rounds. Common questions & project rehearsals.

🎯 Target: 500+ quality problems solved.

fullBlueprint.title: Computer Science – From Beginner to Industry-Ready (12-Month Blueprint)
fullBlueprint.intro: A high-performance roadmap designed by career strategists and senior engineers. This 12-month protocol ensures you transition from a beginner to an industry-ready professional with deep technical mastery.

steps.title: Step 1: Choose One Core Language
steps.content: Recommended: C++ (for DSA focus), Java, or Python (if AI-focused). Don’t switch languages every month. Master the syntax but move to logic quickly.

steps.title: Step 2: Master Programming Fundamentals
steps.content: Focus on: Variables, Loops, Functions, Arrays, Strings, Recursion basics, and Time complexity basics (Big-O). Recommendation: 5 days coding, 2 days revision.

steps.title: Step 3: Start DSA Early (Don’t Delay)
steps.content: Topics: Arrays, Strings, Recursion, Basic Sorting, Searching. Platforms: LeetCode (Easy), GeeksforGeeks, CodeStudio.

steps.title: Step 4: Version Control & GitHub
steps.content: Learn Git basics. Push every practice project. Maintain consistency streak. Your GitHub must not look empty.

steps.title: Step 1: Advanced DSA
steps.content: Topics: Linked List, Stack, Queue, Binary Trees, BST, Hashing, Sliding Window, Two Pointers. Target: 300–350 total problems solved.

steps.title: Step 2: Choose Development Path
steps.content: Specialization: Web Dev (MERN Stack), Data Path (Python/SQL/ML), or Cloud Path (Linux/AWS/Docker).

steps.title: Step 3: Build 3 Real Projects
steps.content: Not tutorial clones. Authentication systems, Blog platforms, E-commerce clones, or REST API projects. Deploy them and link in README.

steps.title: Step 4: Resume Strategy
steps.content: Structure: Skills, Impact-driven project bullets, Problem-solving stats, GitHub links. Avoid fake roles or irrelevant tools.

steps.title: Step 1: Master Patterns in DSA
steps.content: Focus on patterns: DP, Graph, Backtracking, Greedy, Binary search on answer. Target: 500+ quality problems.

steps.title: Step 2: System Design Basics
steps.content: Learn: Scalability, Load balancers, Database indexing, Caching, API rate limiting, CAP theorem. You need fundamentals, not FAANG-level design.

steps.title: Step 3: Internship Strategy
steps.content: Daily LinkedIn outreach, Cold messaging, Hackathons, referrals. 10 applications/day, 5 recruiter messages.

steps.title: Step 4: Interview Preparation
steps.content: Coding Round, Technical Round, HR Round. Prepare 50 common questions, 10 project rehearsals, 5 mock interviews.
